verses.original: אַחַ֣ר׀ הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֣ים דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ הָיָ֤ה אֶל־ אַבְרָ֔ם בַּֽמַּחֲזֶ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אַל־ תִּירָ֣א אַבְרָ֗ם אָנֹכִי֙ לָ֔ךְ מָגֵ֣ן מְאֹֽד׃ הַרְבֵּ֥ה שְׂכָרְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥar hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’el- ’aḇ·rām bam·ma·ḥă·zeh lê·mōr ’al- tî·rā ’aḇ·rām ’ā·nō·ḵî lāḵ mā·ḡên mə·’ōḏ har·bêh śə·ḵā·rə·ḵā
verses.literal: After these events the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision . . . Do not be afraid Abram I [am] your shield your very great reward

verses.original: אַבְרָ֗ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהוִה֙ מַה־ תִּתֶּן־ לִ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עֲרִירִ֑י וּבֶן־ מֶ֣שֶׁק בֵּיתִ֔י ה֖וּא אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃ דַּמֶּ֥שֶׂק
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rām way·yō·mer ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh mah- tit·ten- lî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hō·w·lêḵ ‘ă·rî·rî ū·ḇen- me·šeq bê·ṯî hū ’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer dam·me·śeq
verses.literal: But Abram replied O Lord GOD what can You give me since I remain childless and the heir . . . of my house . . . is Eliezer of Damascus

verses.original: אַבְרָ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הֵ֣ן נָתַ֖תָּה לִ֔י לֹ֥א זָ֑רַע וְהִנֵּ֥ה בֶן־ בֵּיתִ֖י יוֹרֵ֥שׁ אֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rām way·yō·mer hên nā·ṯat·tāh lî lō zā·ra‘ wə·hin·nêh ḇen- bê·ṯî yō·w·rêš ’ō·ṯî
verses.literal: Abram continued Behold You have given me no offspring so a servant in my household will be my heir -

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֑ה לֹ֥א יִֽירָשְׁךָ֖ כִּי־ אִם֙ ה֖וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵצֵ֣א מִמֵּעֶ֔יךָ יִֽירָשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lāw lê·mōr zeh lō yî·rā·šə·ḵā kî- ’im hū ’ă·šer yê·ṣê mim·mê·‘e·ḵā yî·rā·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to [Abram] saying This one will not be your heir but . . . one who comes from your own body will be your heir

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א אֹת֜וֹ הַח֗וּצָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ נָ֣א הַבֶּט־ הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וּסְפֹר֙ הַכּ֣וֹכָבִ֔ים אִם־ תּוּכַ֖ל לִסְפֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ כֹּ֥ה זַרְעֶֽךָ׃ יִהְיֶ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣê ’ō·ṯōw ha·ḥū·ṣāh way·yō·mer nā hab·beṭ- haš·šā·may·māh ū·sə·p̄ōr hak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm ’im- tū·ḵal lis·pōr ’ō·ṯām way·yō·mer lōw kōh zar·‘e·ḵā yih·yeh
verses.literal: And [the LORD] took him outside and said Now look to the heavens and count the stars if you are able . . . - Then He told him So {shall} your offspring be

verses.original: וְהֶאֱמִ֖ן בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶ֥הָ לּ֖וֹ צְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·’ĕ·min Yah·weh way·yaḥ·šə·ḇe·hā lōw ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Abram believed the LORD and it was credited to him as righteousness

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵאתִ֙יךָ֙ מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים לָ֧תֶת לְךָ֛ אֶת־ הַזֹּ֖את הָאָ֥רֶץ לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî·ḵā mê·’ūr kaś·dîm lā·ṯeṯ lə·ḵā ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: [The LORD] also told him I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you - this land to possess

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהוִ֔ה בַּמָּ֥ה אֵדַ֖ע כִּ֥י אִֽירָשֶֽׁנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bam·māh ’ê·ḏa‘ kî ’î·rā·šen·nāh
verses.literal: But [Abram] replied Lord GOD how can I know that I will possess it

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו קְחָ֥ה לִי֙ מְשֻׁלֶּ֔שֶׁת עֶגְלָ֣ה מְשֻׁלֶּ֖שֶׁת וְעֵ֥ז וְאַ֣יִל מְשֻׁלָּ֑שׁ וְתֹ֖ר וְגוֹזָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw qə·ḥāh lî mə·šul·le·šeṯ ‘eḡ·lāh mə·šul·le·šeṯ wə·‘êz wə·’a·yil mə·šul·lāš wə·ṯōr wə·ḡō·w·zāl
verses.literal: And [the LORD] said to him Bring Me - a heifer - a goat and a ram [each] three years old along with a turtledove and a young pigeon

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ כָּל־ אֵ֗לֶּה ל֣וֹ אֶת־ וַיְבַתֵּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן בִּתְר֖וֹ לִקְרַ֣את אִישׁ־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ הַצִפֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־ לֹ֥א בָתָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ- kāl- ’êl·leh lōw ’eṯ- way·ḇat·têr ’ō·ṯām bat·tā·weḵ way·yit·tên biṯ·rōw liq·raṯ ’îš- rê·‘ê·hū ha·ṣip·pōr wə·’eṯ- lō ḇā·ṯār
verses.literal: So [Abram] brought all these to Him - split each of them down the middle and laid the halves opposite each other The birds however he did not cut in half

verses.original: הָעַ֖יִט וַיֵּ֥רֶד עַל־ הַפְּגָרִ֑ים אַבְרָֽם׃ וַיַּשֵּׁ֥ב אֹתָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: hā·‘a·yiṭ way·yê·reḏ ‘al- hap·pə·ḡā·rîm ’aḇ·rām way·yaš·šêḇ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: And the birds of prey descended on the carcasses but Abram drove them away -

verses.original: הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וַיְהִ֤י לָב֔וֹא אַבְרָ֑ם נָפְלָ֣ה עַל־ וְתַרְדֵּמָ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה אֵימָ֛ה חֲשֵׁכָ֥ה נֹפֶ֥לֶת עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: haš·še·meš way·hî lā·ḇō·w ’aḇ·rām nā·p̄ə·lāh ‘al- wə·ṯar·dê·māh wə·hin·nêh ḡə·ḏō·lāh ’ê·māh ḥă·šê·ḵāh nō·p̄e·leṯ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: As the sun was setting Abram fell into a deep sleep and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאַבְרָ֗ם יָדֹ֨עַ תֵּדַ֜ע כִּי־ זַרְעֲךָ֗ יִהְיֶ֣ה גֵ֣ר׀ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ לֹ֣א לָהֶ֔ם וַעֲבָד֖וּם וְעִנּ֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·’aḇ·rām yā·ḏō·a‘ tê·ḏa‘ kî- zar·‘ă·ḵā yih·yeh ḡêr bə·’e·reṣ lō lā·hem wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏūm wə·‘in·nū ’ō·ṯām ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh
verses.literal: Then [the LORD] said to Abram Know for certain . . . that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own and they will be enslaved and mistreated - four hundred years

verses.original: וְגַ֧ם אֶת־ אָנֹ֑כִי דָּ֣ן הַגּ֛וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲבֹ֖דוּ וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֥ן יֵצְא֖וּ גָּדֽוֹל׃ בִּרְכֻ֥שׁ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- ’ā·nō·ḵî dān hag·gō·w ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·ḇō·ḏū wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yê·ṣə·’ū gā·ḏō·wl bir·ḵuš
verses.literal: But - I will judge the nation - they serve as slaves and afterward . . . they will depart with many possessions

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֛ה תָּב֥וֹא אֶל־ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ בְּשָׁל֑וֹם תִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tā·ḇō·w ’el- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā bə·šā·lō·wm tiq·qā·ḇêr bə·śê·ḇāh ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: You, however will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age . . .

verses.original: רְבִיעִ֖י וְד֥וֹר יָשׁ֣וּבוּ הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֧י עֲוֺ֥ן הָאֱמֹרִ֖י לֹא־ עַד־ הֵֽנָּה׃ שָׁלֵ֛ם
verses.transliteration: rə·ḇî·‘î wə·ḏō·wr yā·šū·ḇū hên·nāh kî ‘ă·wōn hā·’ĕ·mō·rî lō- ‘aḏ- hên·nāh šā·lêm
verses.literal: In the fourth generation [your descendants] will return here for the iniquity of the Amorites [is] not yet . . . complete

verses.original: הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ בָּ֔אָה וַעֲלָטָ֖ה וַיְהִ֤י הָיָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה עָשָׁן֙ תַנּ֤וּר אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר וְלַפִּ֣יד עָבַ֔ר בֵּ֖ין הַגְּזָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: haš·še·meš bā·’āh wa·‘ă·lā·ṭāh way·hî hā·yāh wə·hin·nêh ‘ā·šān ṯan·nūr ’êš ’ă·šer wə·lap·pîḏ ‘ā·ḇar bên hag·gə·zā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen . . . behold a smoking firepot and a flaming - torch appeared and passed between the halves [of the carcasses]

verses.original: הַה֗וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם יְהוָ֛ה כָּרַ֧ת בְּרִ֣ית אֶת־ אַבְרָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֗ נָתַ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־ הַזֹּ֔את הָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְּהַ֣ר מִצְרַ֔יִם עַד־ הַגָּדֹ֖ל הַנָּהָ֥ר פְּרָֽת׃ נְהַר־
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm Yah·weh kā·raṯ bə·rîṯ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rām lê·mōr lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ min·nə·har miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- hag·gā·ḏōl han·nā·hār pə·rāṯ nə·har-
verses.literal: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram saying To your descendants I have given - this land from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates . . .

verses.original: אֶת־ הַקֵּינִי֙ וְאֶת־ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַקַּדְמֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- haq·qê·nî wə·’eṯ- haq·qə·niz·zî wə·’êṯ haq·qaḏ·mō·nî
verses.literal: - the land of the Kenites - Kenizzites - Kadmonites

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַחִתִּ֥י וְאֶת־ הַפְּרִזִּ֖י וְאֶת־ הָרְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥit·tî wə·’eṯ- hap·pə·riz·zî wə·’eṯ- hā·rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: - Hittites - Perizzites - Rephaites

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְאֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְאֶת־ הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·’eṯ- hag·gir·gā·šî wə·’eṯ- hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: - Amorites - Canaanites - Girgashites - and Jebusites
